d:
It's the grand finale of the Veggie Paaji Patna Food series, and we're ending it with a bang! Join Veggie Paaji and special guest as they explore the most authentic and delicious breakfast (naashta) spots that locals in Patna swear by.
Forget Litti Chokha for a second; this food tour is all about the true morning flavors of Bihar food. We dive deep into the city's culinary heart, trying things you've probably never seen before!
